messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — launching a PLG test next Tue. Flow = webinar -> prompt-template pack -> starter credits -> activation nudge sequence. Goal: higher first-call-to-success within 7 days, keep unit cost in check. Link to brief: https://docs.redwood.ai/launchsprint (draft).
Liam: Sounds good. For inbound routing I propose: default -> marketing_sdr queue; webinar registrants + high intent -> growth queue. Do we have concrete segment rules yet?
Jas: @Ana @Liam what's our starter credit amount? 100 felt generous on last test. Happy to dial down if we need cost control.
Matt: Tracking checklist: register_webinar, attended_webinar (Y/N), downloaded_prompt_pack, first_api_call, 7d_active. Also need an A/B for nudge copy and timing (24h vs 72h). We'll surface cohorts in GA + internal events table.
Priya: I'll own the prompt pack. Plan: 3 starter templates — Quickstart prompt, ChatOps helper, Email outreach. Will open PR for copy + examples today.
Liam: Draft routing rule (pseudo):
```
if (webinar_registrant && intent_score > 0.7) route = "growth";
else route = "marketing_sdr";
```
I'll add these to the router and mock test in staging.
Jas: OK let's do 75 credits for starter (starter_v2) — reduces risk but still meaningful. Agree on A/B for nudge copy.
Ana: Decision: 75 credits, A/B nudge (copy A = product benefit, copy B = checklist + quickstart). @Matt please add events, @Liam push routing + credit_bucket: `starter_v2`. Priya plz tag me on PR.
Matt: Will add events + funnels. Also creating a simple dashboard: webinar -> prompt pack -> first_api_call -> 7d_retention.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: promo-site changes + routing rules go to staging at 2026-05-01T16:00:00Z.
Liam: Pushing routing to staging now. Will run smoke tests and post results here.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/prompt-packs/pull/421 — includes templates + example outputs.
Ana: Great momentum. Next steps: Liam finish routing, Matt dashboard ready by EOD Friday, Jas confirm credit config with finance, Priya finish PR. Quick sync Friday 10am?
Jas: Friday 10am works. :thumbsup:
Liam: On it.
Matt: Added event specs to the doc.
Priya: Will finish copy tonight.
Ana: Thanks team — appreciate quick turnaround.
